title: Retain the Highest-Priority Items
prerequisite: Frequency maps from Lesson 4. A tested MinPriorityQueue is supplied.
hints: First count each number’s frequency. After counting, each distinct number is one candidate with a numeric priority.
Keep a min-priority queue of at most k candidates so the least frequent retained candidate is cheapest to evict.
Enqueue every frequency entry and dequeue whenever size exceeds k; the remaining k values are the answer.
